statement: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN plan up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure starting in 2027, within a joint-venture target of up to 1 GW by 2030.
why: A gigawatt-scale pipeline anchored on Instinct parts is meaningful non-NVIDIA accelerator capacity, which widens the buyer's set of options.

impact.mechanism: Committed megawatts on AMD silicon add credible alternative accelerator supply and pull matching power, cooling and colocation buildout in the Kingdom.

evidence.excerpt: up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure
up to 1 GW of AI infrastructure by 2030

confidence.basis: Primary AMD press release; note the figures are stated as 'up to' targets for phases beginning 2027, not contracted volumes.
